[Barely Possible 2026-05-12]

Today's episode:
• Google confirmed the first criminal AI-generated zero-day exploit; OpenAI announced "Daybreak" cyber defense the same day.
• Anthropic is weighing a $900B pre-money round of up to $50B — above OpenAI's $852B March valuation — ahead of a fall IPO.
• Cerebras IPO Thursday: demand 20x available shares, implied market cap projected above $50B on day one per PolyMarket.

Hear the full breakdown in today's episode of Barely Possible.
